letter: Most of this week's sentences went through cleanly, and two-kanji words held up well, including some you hadn't met before.
What still trips you is length: most misses dropped a long vowel. It's a listening habit more than a kanji one.
There are grammar patterns from this lesson you haven't used in a sentence of your own yet. Reading them isn't the same as owning them.

plan.what: A short reading session. Some sentences focus on long vowels.
Write one sentence with a grammar pattern you haven't used yet.
